decks.notes: The deck focuses on disruption, card advantage, and resource denial to control the game. It runs a playset of powerful counterspells like Force of Will and Force of Negation to disrupt the opponent's plays. It also utilizes efficient removal spells like Fatal Push to deal with threats. Ancestral Recall, Ponder, and Treasure Cruise provide card advantage and help draw into key pieces. Strip Mine and Wasteland are used to disrupt the opponent's mana base. Overall, the deck aims to control the game, disrupt the opponent, and win through incremental advantage.

This deck focuses on utilizing the powerful Underworld Breach combo to generate infinite spells and mana to overwhelm the opponent. By recurring cards from the graveyard and casting multiple spells in a single turn, the deck aims to quickly establish a dominant position on the battlefield. The inclusion of Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion provides additional value and recursion options. The deck also features a variety of powerful Vintage staples such as Ancestral Recall, Black Lotus, and Force of Will to help protect and further enable the combo strategy.

The focus of this Dimir Control deck is on disruption and resource denial, utilizing powerful counterspells like Force of Will and Force of Negation alongside versatile removal spells like Fatal Push. The deck also includes card advantage engines like Ancestral Recall and Treasure Cruise to maintain control of the game. Additionally, the inclusion of Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion provides additional flexibility and resilience in longer games. The deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver opponents through efficient answers and card advantage while setting up for powerful late-game win conditions.

This control deck focuses on utilizing Oath of Druids to cheat powerful creatures into play quickly, while also disrupting opponent's strategy with counterspells like Force of Will and Force of Negation. It also includes cards like Show and Tell and Stock Up to further advance its game plan. The deck has a strong mana base with Moxen and lands like Ancient Tomb and Boseiju, Who Endures, allowing for fast and efficient casting of spells. In addition, planeswalkers like Oko, Thief of Crowns provide additional utility and threats.

The deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan through the use of counterspells, removal spells, and hand disruption. It aims to control the game by denying the opponent resources, while also having card advantage through draw spells like Ancestral Recall and Treasure Cruise. With powerful cards like Force of Will and Demonic Tutor, along with efficient removal like Fatal Push, the deck looks to out-value the opponent and establish a dominant position on the board. Additionally, the inclusion of Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion provides a recurring threat and extra resources for the late game.

The deck focuses on quickly generating mana with artifact accelerants like Moxen, Sol Ring, and Grim Monolith to power out powerful threats like Karn, the Great Creator, and Tezzeret, Cruel Captain. The deck then aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan with disruptive artifacts like Chalice of the Void and Pithing Needle. Additionally, the deck utilizes combos like Time Vault and Manifold Key or Mystic Forge and Sensei's Divining Top to close out the game quickly. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive artifact-based threats while disrupting their strategy.

This deck focuses on utilizing artifact creatures and artifacts to build a powerful aggressive strategy. By combining creatures like Glaring Fleshraker and Scrawling Crawler with powerful artifacts such as The One Ring and Time Vault, the deck aims to quickly overwhelm opponents and disrupt their game plan. Cards like Tezzeret, Cruel Captain and Karn, the Great Creator provide additional support and versatility, while mana acceleration from cards like Mishra's Workshop and Grim Monolith allow for explosive plays. The deck's goal is to establish a dominant board presence and close out games swiftly.

This deck focuses on using powerful reanimation spells like Entomb and Reanimate to quickly bring back high-impact creatures from the graveyard, such as Grief and Atraxa, Grand Unifier. By using disruption spells like Force of Will and Daze to protect their combo pieces, the player aims to control the game and win through a fast and lethal combination of spells. The deck also includes cards like Ancestral Recall and Brainstorm for card advantage and selection, ensuring the player can find their combo pieces quickly and efficiently.

The deck revolves around assembling a powerful combo utilizing Coveted Jewel to generate mana and card advantage, enabling the player to either win the game through a massive mana advantage or disrupt the opponent's strategy with cards like Force of Will. By utilizing artifact ramp and powerful tutor effects, the deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent before they can react effectively. The inclusion of cards like Lodestone Golem and Mishra's Workshop also aids in slowing down the opponent's game plan, allowing the deck to execute its strategy smoothly.

This Dimir Control deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan with a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and disruptive creatures like Orcish Bowmasters and Psychic Frog. The deck also includes efficient card draw spells like Ancestral Recall, Dig Through Time, and Treasure Cruise to maintain card advantage. The inclusion of Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion allows for recurring key permanents from the graveyard. Overall, this deck aims to control the game through disruption while maintaining card advantage and board presence.

The main concept of this Vintage 1 vs 1 Aggro - Hatebear deck is to disrupt the opponent's spells and mana base while applying pressure with aggressive creatures. The deck utilizes disruptive hatebears like Anointed Peacekeeper, Archon of Emeria, and Chancellor of the Annex to slow down the opponent, while also using cards like Void Mirror and Clarion Conqueror to disrupt their strategies. The deck also includes mana acceleration with Moxen and Ancient Tomb, as well as card advantage with Seasoned Dungeoneer and Witch Enchanter. The goal is to control the game while applying pressure to quickly close out the game.

The deck aims to control the game by utilizing Oath of Druids to put powerful creatures like Atraxa, Grand Unifier into play quickly. It also has disruptive elements like Thoughtseize and Force of Will to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Show and Tell and Boseiju, Who Endures provide additional ways to cheat creatures into play and protect them from counterspells. The deck also includes powerful cards like Ancestral Recall and Time Walk to draw cards and take extra turns, further cementing its control over the game.

This Dimir Control deck focuses on using disruption and card advantage to control the game. It uses counterspells like Force of Will and Spell Pierce, removal like Fatal Push, and card draw like Ancestral Recall and Treasure Cruise to maintain control over the game. The inclusion of cards like Lurrus of the Dream-Den and Psychic Frog allows for recursion and card advantage, while the land destruction from Wasteland and Strip Mine can disrupt the opponent's mana base. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver the opponent to secure victory.

Fast-paced UR Aggro deck utilizing efficient mana acceleration from artifacts to quickly deploy threats like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Hexing Squelcher. This deck aims to disrupt opponent's strategy with countermagic like Force of Will and Force of Negation while also abusing card advantage with Dack Fayden and Treasure Cruise. The deck is rounded out with versatile removal and card selection spells to maintain pressure on the opponent and close out the game quickly.

This deck relies on filling the graveyard with cards like Golgari Grave-Troll, Stinkweed Imp, and Golgari Thug to trigger powerful abilities like Dredge and bringing back creatures like Prized Amalgam and Narcomoeba. By using cards like Bazaar of Baghdad and Creeping Chill, the deck aims to quickly fill the graveyard and overwhelm the opponent with a constant stream of creatures. Force of Will and Force of Negation provide protection, while Cabal Therapy allows for disruption of the opponent's strategy. This deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and win the game in a burst of activity.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize the powerful graveyard synergy of cards like Vengevine, Squee, Goblin Nabob, and Hollow One to create a fast and aggressive playstyle. The key strategy is to quickly fill up the graveyard with cards through effects like Bazaar of Baghdad and Serum Powder, and then bring back creatures and apply pressure on the opponent. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Mindbreak Trap and Force of Will to protect its own game plan and counter opposing threats. It is a high-risk, high-reward deck that aims to overwhelm the opponent with unexpected and explosive plays.
